爱莎贝儿-144CM-M 粉肤 RAD041 蝶野未梦Chono Miyu-红色心跳
在柔和灯光下，她身着不同往常的护士裙，胸前的红色布料紧紧贴合着她那傲人的曲线。
俯身时，丰满曲线贴近我的身体，红唇轻吐热气：“先生，需要我用心跳加速的特别护理吗？”
纤指划过胸口，暧昧温度直达心底，空气中混着她甜香，我的心跳随着她的节奏越来越快……
胸型：144CM-M 粉肤

Elsa Babe-144CM-M Pink RAD041 Chono Miyu-Red Heartbeat
Under the soft light, she wore an unusual nurse's dress, the red fabric clinging tightly to her alluring curves.
As she leaned forward, her full figure pressed close to mine, her red lips exhaling warm breath: "Sir, would you like some special treatment that will make your heart race?"
Her slender fingers traced her chest, the ambiguous warmth reaching my heart, her sweet fragrance filling the air, my heartbeat quickening with her rhythm…
Body type: 144CM-M with Pink skin tone.
